title: How to start an SMMA in 2026 with $0: the shadow operator model for micro creators
summary: Iman lays out a 9-step SMMA roadmap, contrasting the traditional local-business route with a "shadow operator" model. In it you partner with micro creators (20k-100k followers), use AI instead of contractors, and take a revenue split instead of selling retainers. Covers niche, offer, outreach, sales, pricing and launch.

principles.text: Pick unsophisticated buyers: if they already do the service at 6/10, you must beat that; if they do nothing, a 4/10 still wins.
principles.quote: Pick unsophisticated businesses where the business owner has no idea how to do the service that you offer.

principles.text: Niche down to simplify: one niche means the same prospecting, outreach, sales, delivery and offer, instead of running several businesses at once.
principles.quote: When you have multiple niches, it's literally like running multiple different businesses at one go.

principles.text: Target micro creators who already have the audience; skip the hardest problem of getting eyes on a product nobody knows.
principles.quote: They already have the eyes and the attention. They just don't have the back-end strategy to launch the product and monetize that attention.

principles.text: Charge a revenue split instead of selling retainers: no upfront ask means no risk for the creator, and the sale becomes an opportunity pitch.
principles.quote: You're not convincing them to pay you any money upfront. No, no, no. There's a very big difference here.

principles.text: Automate the split at the moment of sale so the partner never feels like they're paying you; every manual payment invites a reconsideration.
principles.quote: Every recall is a reframe. Basically, every time someone needs to remember to pay you, they reconsider if it's worth it.

principles.text: Set a non-negotiable daily outreach floor (the bare minimum) plus a stretch target, and keep the first message short, personal and ending in a question.
principles.quote: BAM stands for bare ass minimum. This is the number of outreach messages you will do every single day, no matter what.
